notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Tireless Tribe.
description:
Cast Inside Out by paying {1}{U/R}, targeting Tireless Tribe and then drawing a card.
Activate Tireless Tribe by discarding a card, giving it +4/+0 as its power and toughness are switched.
Repeat step 2 as able.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tireless Tribe.
